verdict.rationale: Runpod documents creating, starting, stopping, and terminating Pods via the CLI (runpodctl pod create) and via the GraphQL API, and its REST API v1 covers programmatic access to all compute resources. Billing is per second for compute and storage, so you pay only for what runs. missing for 10: an explicitly documented restart operation, detail on what a stopped Pod still costs (storage versus compute), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the lifecycle API.
